'''Tolmeran''' is a [[High Lord]] from [[Tear]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is lean with an iron gray beard.

== Activities ==
He is one of the High Lords under the command of [[Weiramon]]. He is sent to the [[Plains of Maredo]] where [[Rand al'Thor]] is gathering a massive army for the imminent attack on [[Illian]].

He goes with Rand when Rand tries to deal with the Illian rebels loyal to Lord Brend. Rand sends a force led by him south of Illian to keep any hostile forces at bay.

He leaves with his forces from Illian to return to Tear, against Rand's wishes.
